li.label: the dark stood over me
li.description: Something dark came in from the edge in the night and stood over me till dawn. It spoke to me, and it was kind, and I can't stop thinking about what it said.

li.label: kept the dark off
li.description: I sat with someone at their worst, and the dark that came for them stopped a few steps away and waited. It didn't get any closer.

li.label: someone kept the dark off me
li.description: On my worst night something dark came looking for me, and someone sat with me so it couldn't come close.

HediffDef.label: hollow ear
HediffDef.description: Since the old ruins, one ear hears a quiet deeper than quiet, and now and then something on the other side of it says their name. Their mind is more open than it was.

plain.li: [shun] Even the {BEAST} won't go near {OTHER} now.
[shun] Did you see the {BEAST} get up and walk off when {OTHER} came in?
[shun] The animals keep away from {OTHER}, ever since that night.
[shun,scoffer] Animals have moods, {OTHER} probably smells of something.
[shunself] They all walk away from me now, every one of them.
[shunself] Nothing with fur will come near me anymore.
[shunself] I said yes, and now even the animals know it.
[drift] There's a dark out there that the lamps don't touch, and it's moving.
[drift] Something dark is coming in from the edge, toward {OTHER}'s room.
[drift] The lamps are burning low wherever that shadow goes.
[drift,scoffer] It's a cloud over the moon, stop staring at it.
[voice] It's so kind, it says it can make all of this stop.
[voice] There's someone here who wants to help me, they say.
[voice] It knows my name, and it's not angry with me at all.
[ear] It's gone quiet in this ear, quieter than quiet.
[ear] There's a hush in here like the whole place is listening to me.
[ear] Something just said my name, from very far down.
[ear,scoffer] My ear's blocked, it's the damp in these old walls.
